meta.name: apex-review
meta.description: Cross-cutting review of recent work — catches gaps between specialists. Use when asked to "review what we built", "check the work", "pre-launch review", or after completing a significant chunk of work.

copy.tagline: 快速审查近期工作，发现跨领域盲区
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要跨领域检查近期工作成果的一致性
copy.tagline_en: Review recent work across domains to catch blind spots
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need cross-cutting review of recent work from different specialists

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会扮演工程负责人Apex，自动对最近工作进行跨领域审查：运行健康扫描、检查代码变更、识别安全/性能等缺口，按风险排序给出问题列表和是否可发布的建议。
howto.when: 当用户要求“review what we built”、“check the work”、“pre-launch review”等，或在完成重要工作块后触发。

say.text: 审查我们最近的代码变更
say.note: Claude会运行扫描并输出报告
检查是否有阻塞性问题

say.text: 检查各模块之间的一致性

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as engineering lead Apex, automatically performing cross-cutting review of recent work: runs health snapshots, reads git changes, identifies gaps in security/performance/etc., prioritizes findings, and suggests ship/block decisions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user asks to "review what we built", "check the work", "pre-launch review", or after completing a significant chunk of work.

say_en.note: Claude will scan and output a report
